quest.title: Relics of Seirai
quest.description: You rescue a woman named Fujiwara Toshiko on Seirai Island. She seems to be searching for a family heirloom here...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x400, Primogem x50, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

talks.objective: Rescue the person surrounded by monsters

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: Th—Thank you... Phew, to think that these guys would try to catch me unaware like that...

response.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
response.text: I'm Fujiwara Toshiko, and I'm here to... Um...

response.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
response.text: Never mind. Since you did save me, I might as well tell you.

response.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
response.text: I'm actually here to find treasure that my ancestors left behind here!

response.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
response.text: Hahaha, of course I have. I've followed some clues to the treasure's location, and I've ascertained my method of entry.

response.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
response.text: But just as I was about to activate the switch and enter the area where the treasure is stored, those monsters sneaked up and attacked me.

response.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
response.text: I owe you my life for chasing those monsters away. Thank you.

response.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
response.text: Could I ask you to protect me for a while longer?

response.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
response.text: I still have to find that treasure, but I don't think I'll be able to handle all these monsters alone...

response.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
response.text: I'll... I'll even share some of the treasure with you!

response.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
response.text: I'm sure I can find that treasure! Just trust me!

response.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
response.text: I've even found the switch that'll allow us to enter the place where the treasure is hidden. It's just over there.

response.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
response.text: That said, the mechanism doesn't seem to be something we can open directly. It requires some special method to activate...

response.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
response.text: I have a map left by my ancestors here with me, and it contains clues as to how I might figure this mechanism out...

response.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
response.text: But... Heh, I still haven't figured it out yet.

response.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
response.text: Here, why don't you have a look as well? For all I know, you might be able to figure something out.

response.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
response.text: *sigh* But really, how am I supposed to solve this puzzle...

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: This mechanism seems to be of the same kind as the one that we unlocked on the way in.

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: Just, you know... more complicated...

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: But it's fine, right? I'm sure the ancestral map I've got has some clues for us!

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: The camp's not far now, we'll reach it in just a moment...

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: Wh—What was that noise...

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: Did you just see that? A giant... hole just opened up over there!

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: Looks like there's... some sort of basement here! Let's go in and have a look, come on!

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: Eh? What is it this time...

dialogues.speaker: Treasure Hoarder
dialogues.text: Struck it rich, did you?

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: Y—You...

dialogues.speaker: Treasure Hoarder
dialogues.text: Hehe. Come on now, cut it with the nonsense. Give it up, or else! We're not leaving empty-handed...

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: What? Wait a moment! All I found was this picture!

dialogues.speaker: Treasure Hoarder
dialogues.text: A picture? Well, we'll take that too! Come on lads, get 'er!

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: H—Help me, Traveler, please!

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: Ohh, what now!?

dialogues.speaker: Fatui
dialogues.text: Hand that picture over.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Fatui!? Wh—What are they doing here!?

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: It's just your ordinary, normal, run-of-the-mill picture! If you want it, just take it, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Fatui
dialogues.text: Is there anything else? Hand those over too!

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: Anything else? There's nothing else! I really only found this one picture!

dialogues.speaker: Fatui
dialogues.text: Hmph! Why would one crummy picture be hidden by so many complex mechanisms?

dialogues.speaker: Fatui
dialogues.text: If we hadn't trailed those samurai, we wouldn't have found this basement at all.

dialogues.speaker: Fatui
dialogues.text: We're not leaving empty-handed after so much waiting. Get them!

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: I... I really... Traveler, please, help me!

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: Just when did we catch the eye of those Treasure Hoarders...

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: Thank you, Traveler, let's head back to camp.

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: Wh—What is going on...

dialogues.speaker: Masterless Samurai
dialogues.text: Please halt.

dialogues.speaker: Masterless Samurai
dialogues.text: Could we bother you to leave the treasure you found with us?

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: What...

dialogues.speaker: Masterless Samurai
dialogues.text: Did you not just fight those Treasure Hoarders off to protect the treasure you found?

dialogues.speaker: Masterless Samurai
dialogues.text: It stands to reason, then, that it must be something very valuable.

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: I thought I said that it was just one picture!

dialogues.speaker: Masterless Samurai
dialogues.text: It seems we are at an impasse, then. But we shall not be denied, not after following those Treasure Hoarders for all this time. Attack!

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: H—Hey, listen to me, will you!? Traveler! Help!

talks.objective: Wait for Fujiwara Toshiko to open the chest

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: These people aren't listening to me at all! I said it already, we only found one picture!

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: Let's go. We need to get back to my campsite...

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: Why's there only this inside...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: Other than this picture, there's nothing in this chest.

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: Is this the treasure? That's so odd.

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: *sigh* I don't think we can split this, can we...

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: Well, how about this, then? Let's head back to my camp first.

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: I'll provide you with the payment once we get back there.

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: Right, then. Let's go.

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: Only one picture? How strange...

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: Wh—Why doesn't anyone believe that this picture is all I found? I mean...

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: You've got to at least let your victim tell you what they've got while you're robbing them, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's just go...

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: *whimpers* A—Alright... Let's just get back to camp. I've had enough of this...

talks.objective: Follow Fujiwara Toshiko to the camp

dialogues.text: Meow!

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: Agh! Wh—Who is it this time! Please, I just found this one picture, that's all I found, honest!

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: I'm sorry! I'm sorry! I'll never go looking for treasure ever again!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's just a cat...

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: Eh? Is it? Oh...

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: Phew, we're back at last. Hold on for a moment while I get your payment ready.

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: That should do it. This isn't much, but please accept it.

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: This treasure hunt sure turned out to be a mess — and all that for a single picture.

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: Why would my ancestors set up so many mechanisms just to protect one picture?

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: I don't get it at all. Maybe I should bring this picture back to Inazuma City and ask around a bit...

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: Hmm, maybe I should go ask Mr. Oda Tarou...

dialogues.speaker: Fujiwara Toshiko
dialogues.text: How am I supposed to solve this puzzle...
